title: A begin-unknown hold whose begin met a routing-token-invalidating error has no way forward but Cancel: Resume resends under the dead token
outcome: A head held because its begin got a structured error invalidating the routing token (control_session_not_bound and the rest of engram_code_invalidates_routing_token) has a safe way forward that does not discard a possibly begun prompt: a rebind-plus-status route that settles the grant. Or the docs state plainly that Resume repeats the dead-token begin and that only Cancel, or the restart path once boot reconstruction lands, ends it.
acceptance: A begin-unknown hold whose begin met a routing-token-invalidating error has no way forward but Cancel: Resume resends under the dead token is done
